milestones.title: List contract and paginated API
acceptance_criteria: GET /v1/projects returns projects containing only id, externalKey, name, revision and updatedAt plus a nextCursor field
Following nextCursor until null visits every project exactly once in updated_at DESC, id DESC order
Invalid limit or cursor values return 400 with error code VALIDATION_ERROR

milestones.title: Web screens keep working
acceptance_criteria: The projects page lists every project even when more than one page exists
Open tabs for projects beyond the first page are not pruned after refresh

milestones.title: External consumer notice and release gate
acceptance_criteria: docs/api-contract.md documents the paginated list contract and the breaking-change migration path
The owner decision D1 and the trainingApp-mcp compatibility or notice outcome are recorded before any deploy

tasks.title: Add list item and page schemas to contracts
tasks.objective: Shared strict ProjectListItem and ProjectListPage schemas and types exist in @training/contracts without changing the generated import schema
tasks.estimate_rationale: Two small zod schemas next to existing ProjectSnapshotSchema plus a couple of test cases; no comparable execution history, so this is an unmeasured estimate
acceptance_criteria: ProjectListItemSchema accepts exactly id, externalKey, name, revision and updatedAt and rejects an item carrying data
ProjectListPageSchema requires projects and a nextCursor that is a string or null
contracts/project-import.v1.schema.json and its sha256 sidecar are unchanged after regeneration

verification.purpose: list schema accept and reject cases
contracts package types compile with new exports

verification.value: run npm run contracts:generate and compare contracts/project-import.v1.schema.json.sha256 with its previous content
verification.expected: sha256 sidecar content is identical to before the change

complexity.justification: Mirrors the existing strict ProjectSnapshotSchema pattern with a field subset, no design choice left open

scope.justification: One source file and its test file change; the generator only emits ProjectImportSchema so generated artifacts stay as they are

duration.justification: Adding two schema declarations and two node test cases in an existing test file is a short edit
evidence: assumption:no comparable execution history in this sandbox

risk.justification: The schema becomes the shared list contract consumed by API and web, so a wrong field set propagates

coupling.justification: Repository, route and web client consume this contract through the project-list-contract resource

confidence.justification: The contracts package layout, exports and tests were read directly, but no timing history exists

tasks.title: Keyset-paginated project listing in the repository
tasks.objective: ProjectRepository exposes listPage returning list items and nextCursor with deterministic keyset pagination that never reads data_json
tasks.estimate_rationale: Keyset SQL with tie-breaker, opaque cursor encode/decode and boundary tests in an existing better-sqlite3 test harness; estimate is unmeasured
acceptance_criteria: listPage orders by updated_at DESC then id DESC and returns at most limit items
nextCursor is null exactly when no further rows exist and an empty database returns an empty page
Full traversal over rows with equal updated_at values returns every project exactly once
A cursor whose referenced project was deleted still yields the correct next page
A malformed cursor raises a typed error instead of returning rows

verification.purpose: repository pagination boundary and traversal cases

complexity.justification: Requires choosing a stable keyset predicate with an id tie-breaker because current ordering has none

scope.justification: Only the repository listing method and its tests change; mutation paths and snapshot mapping stay untouched

duration.justification: SQL plus cursor helper plus five boundary test cases in the existing temp-database test style
evidence: assumption:no comparable execution history in this sandbox

risk.justification: A wrong predicate skips or duplicates projects across pages, a functional regression for every list caller

coupling.justification: Implements the project-list-contract shape from T1 and is consumed directly by the route task

confidence.justification: Schema, current query and sole caller were inspected; cursor edge cases may add test time

tasks.title: Paginated GET /v1/projects route with HTTP test
tasks.objective: GET /v1/projects validates limit and cursor and responds with the projects plus nextCursor page shape for browser and bearer callers
tasks.estimate_rationale: Route change is one line plus query validation; most time is a new HTTP test booting createApp on an ephemeral port; unmeasured estimate
acceptance_criteria: A bearer-authenticated request returns 200 with items containing only the five list fields and a nextCursor
Requests without session or token still return 401 UNAUTHENTICATED
limit outside 1..100, non-integer limit or malformed cursor return 400 with error code VALIDATION_ERROR
Chaining nextCursor through the HTTP endpoint returns all seeded projects once
The existing repository revision test keeps passing

verification.purpose: HTTP list contract, auth and validation cases plus existing tests
route compiles with new repository method

complexity.justification: Query validation must map into the existing VALIDATION_ERROR handler while keeping auth middleware unchanged

scope.justification: A single route handler changes and one new test file is added; other project routes are untouched

duration.justification: New HTTP test needs a test AppConfig with mcpToken and an ephemeral server, more setup than unit tests
evidence: assumption:no comparable execution history in this sandbox

risk.justification: Changes a public response shape read by the external trainingApp-mcp bearer client, a compatibility hazard

coupling.justification: Produces the projects-list-http-contract consumed by the web client, docs and release gate tasks

confidence.justification: Route, error handler and auth were read; the HTTP harness does not exist yet and adds uncertainty

tasks.title: Web client follows nextCursor and returns the complete list
tasks.objective: listProjects aggregates every page into the unchanged projects array or throws, so existing screens never receive a partial list
tasks.estimate_rationale: One client function rewritten as a bounded loop with a typed page response; both call sites stay unchanged; unmeasured estimate
acceptance_criteria: listProjects returns all projects across pages in API order with the existing return shape
A failed page, a repeated cursor or exceeding the page guard throws instead of returning partial results
project-list.tsx and project-tabs-bar.tsx compile without changes to their listProjects call sites

verification.purpose: client and consumers type-check against the page response

complexity.justification: A bounded cursor-following loop over the existing request helper is a known localized pattern

scope.justification: Only listProjects and its response type change while both component call sites remain as they are

duration.justification: Small function rewrite plus typecheck and lint, no web test harness to extend
evidence: assumption:no comparable execution history in this sandbox

risk.justification: Returning a partial list would make the tabs bar prune open tabs for projects on later pages

coupling.justification: Consumes the projects-list-http-contract produced by the route task and feeds both web list screens

confidence.justification: Client code and both consumers were read; behavior is only verifiable manually because web has no tests

tasks.estimate_rationale: Seeding more projects than one page and clicking through two screens locally; unmeasured estimate
acceptance_criteria: The projects page shows every seeded project with name, externalKey, revision and relative update time
An open tab for a project beyond the first page remains open after navigation refresh
Deleting a project removes it from the list and closes its tab

verification.value: run API and web locally with more projects than one page and exercise /projects and the tabs bar
verification.purpose: web screens keep working with pagination
verification.expected: all projects listed, later-page tabs stay open, deleted project tab closes

verification.value: compare project card fields and ordering against the pre-change behavior
verification.purpose: no visible regression in list rendering

complexity.justification: Scripted manual walk-through of two known screens with no investigation required

scope.justification: Verification only; no repository files are expected to change during this pass

duration.justification: Creating enough projects through the UI or API and checking the two screens takes a short session
evidence: assumption:local dev stack starts without extra setup

coupling.justification: Only reads the web-project-list-screens resource after T4 and edits nothing shared

tasks.title: Document the list contract and breaking-change notice
tasks.objective: API documentation states the paginated list contract and tells external callers how to migrate to full snapshots
tasks.estimate_rationale: One short documentation section derived from the T3 behavior; unmeasured estimate
acceptance_criteria: docs/api-contract.md lists limit and cursor parameters, the response shape, ordering and VALIDATION_ERROR cases
The doc states the cursor is opaque and that concurrent updates can skip a project during one traversal
The doc contains a breaking-change notice directing MCP callers to GET /v1/projects/:id or by-external-key for full snapshots

verification.value: read docs/api-contract.md against the behavior asserted by apps/api/test/projects-route.test.ts
verification.expected: every documented parameter, field and error matches the route test

complexity.justification: Prose describing behavior already fixed by the route task and its test

scope.justification: A single existing documentation page gains one section and nothing else changes

duration.justification: Short page edit comparable in size to the existing fifteen-line contract document

risk.justification: A documentation mistake is reversible and does not change runtime behavior

coupling.justification: Describes the projects-list-http-contract and is unordered relative to the web client work that also consumes it

confidence.justification: The target document and the external consumer description were read directly

tasks.title: Decision-gated release check for trainingApp-mcp (D1)
tasks.objective: Before any deploy, the owner D1 choice and the trainingApp-mcp compatibility or acknowledged notice are recorded, or the plan is revised
tasks.estimate_rationale: Depends on owner availability and access to the external repository, neither of which is known here
acceptance_criteria: The owner D1 decision between break-with-notice and a compatibility mode is recorded
trainingApp-mcp usage of GET /v1/projects is confirmed compatible or updated, or its owner acknowledged the notice
If D1 selects a compatibility mode, release is stopped and a plan revision 2 is requested instead

verification.value: review the recorded D1 decision and the trainingApp-mcp compatibility or acknowledgement evidence before deploy
verification.purpose: no external consumer is broken without notice
verification.expected: a recorded decision plus confirmation or acknowledgement exists before the release SHA is deployed

verification.value: re-check web list and tabs behavior from T5 on the release candidate build
verification.purpose: existing web screens still work at release
verification.expected: same results as T5 on the release candidate

complexity.justification: Requires judging an external consumer that cannot be inspected from this workspace

scope.justification: Records a decision and a compatibility outcome; it changes no code in this repository

duration.justification: Reviewing a recorded decision is short, but waiting on external owners is unbounded
evidence: assumption:owner and trainingApp-mcp maintainer respond within the release window

risk.justification: Releasing without this gate could break the bearer-authenticated MCP integration in production
